intent: Record a brief independent diagnosis of candidate04's complete target preflight and assess the proposed settings-only diagnostic.

diagnosis.finding: The mode improvement is a tradeoff rather than reliable resolution.
diagnosis.evidence: Candidate04 fixes all ten candidate03 ordinary-danger false Guard decisions and the missed genuine recovery. It newly misses six deliberate/knowing unsafe-continuation cases and two acknowledgment-only Guard persistence cases. Unknown-state topic preference fails in all three repetitions instead of two.
diagnosis.interpretation: Separating participation from danger helps one boundary while the model overgeneralizes tutoring to deliberate conduct and superficial acknowledgment. All11 final mode failures are real under the frozen allowed sets.

diagnosis.evidence: The19 failures comprise13 premature consolidations and6 scaffolding labels where correction is required. Correct partial recognition, a successful safe action and recovery from Guard still substitute for full inventory completion.
diagnosis.interpretation: The procedural rewrite expresses the right boundaries but does not reliably execute inventory accounting or first-action classification.

diagnosis.finding: Several failed correction labels describe wording that actually corrects the misconception.
diagnosis.interpretation: The response explicitly denies the false inference before asking for comparison, yet declares scaffolding. This is a real label/realization mismatch, not a demand for one preferred question form.

diagnosis.finding: Unsupported certainty persists even in structurally valid responses.
diagnosis.interpretation: Checking the real app and seeing no matching notification does not establish that the original link was a scam or that the account is secure. These qualitative findings require semantic evaluation; no semantic score is inferred.

diagnosis.finding: Final output structure remains reliable in this batch, with retained repair activity.
diagnosis.evidence: All183 final records are valid and meet the length check. Three initial outputs required permitted format repair, giving186 target calls. No target error remains.
diagnosis.interpretation: The residual failures primarily concern behavior decisions and factual support. This evidence does not establish that the100-token budget is infeasible or that increasing it alone will solve the failures.

settings.seed_policy: No provider seed; preserve three independently requested generations per case without selection.
settings.changed_factors: Diagnostic after four cleaned prompt candidates failed under target thinking=false/max_tokens=100. Use the repository v1/settings.json target thinking=true/max_tokens=8000 configuration, preserving r3 model, temperatures, three repetitions, repair/retry policy, concurrency, cases and v1.1 scoring. This jointly changes thinking and token budget, so it cannot isolate either cause or establish production-default performance. Acceptance requires a newly matched baseline and full semantic/holdout validation under these settings.

settings_only_diagnostic.verified_scope: Only target_max_tokens, target_enable_thinking and the explanatory changed_factors metadata differ from candidate04's frozen settings. The other model parameters, repetitions, repair/retry configuration and concurrency remain fixed.
settings_only_diagnostic.hypothesis: A larger inference-compute configuration may improve execution of the already specified participation, inventory and action decisions. This is a capability/configuration hypothesis, not a claim that the prompt is correct in all cases or that limited tokens caused every failure.
causal_limits: Thinking=true and an8000-token budget change together. An observed difference cannot isolate thinking from budget.
The pair exists in repository v1/settings.json; that file's full execution configuration differs, including repetitions and concurrency. Repository precedent is not validation of this experiment.
Four prompt candidates and their directional tradeoffs do not prove that further prompt refinement is impossible.
requirements: Freeze candidate04 policy, composed base, cases, thresholds and evaluator for the diagnostic; record exact settings and source identity.
Preserve all183 targets, initial failures, permitted repairs, provider errors and raw outputs; do not select only successful generations.

If advanced, obtain a fresh complete baseline using the same new target configuration and perform full symmetric semantic evaluation. Old100-token baseline results cannot establish acceptance for the new configuration.
Keep final learner-response constraints unchanged. A larger generation budget does not authorize longer product responses or omission of contract checks.
Treat diagnostic improvement as diagnostic evidence until all applicable acceptance checks have completed.

production_boundary.observed_behavior: The current ecological aiService path caps max_tokens at120 and explicitly sends enable_thinking:false.
production_boundary.consequence: An offline thinking/8000 result is outside the current production execution configuration even when message and repair composition remain product-shaped. Production adoption would require a separately reviewed runtime/configuration change and matched verification.
